what_it_is.prose: MDL is India's premier defence shipyard, building destroyers, frigates, submarines and offshore patrol vessels for the Indian Navy. Major programmes include: Project 75 (6 Scorpène-class submarines with Naval Group France — INS Kalvari through INS Vaghsheer, last delivered Dec 2024); Project 15B (4 Visakhapatnam-class stealth guided-missile destroyers — INS Visakhapatnam commissioned Nov 2021, INS Mormugao Dec 2022, INS Imphal Dec 2023, INS Surat Jan 2025); and Project 17A (3 of 7 Nilgiri-class stealth frigates built at MDL — INS Nilgiri delivered Dec 2024, INS Himgiri delivered Aug 2025). MDL has built 801 vessels since 1960. The Navy is considering procuring three additional Kalvari-class / P-75I-upgraded submarines (Jun 2026).

rows.india_status: 6 diesel-electric attack submarines built at MDL under transfer of technology from Naval Group (France). INS Kalvari commissioned Dec 2017; INS Vaghsheer (6th) delivered Dec 2024. Navy considering 3 additional subs based on P-75I / upgraded Kalvari tech
4 destroyers (7,300 t displacement, 163 m length). INS Visakhapatnam commissioned Nov 2021; INS Mormugao Dec 2022; INS Imphal (D68) Dec 2023; INS Surat commissioned Jan 15, 2025 — final ship of class

MDL building 3 of 7 Nilgiri-class (Project 17A) frigates. INS Nilgiri delivered Dec 2024; INS Himgiri delivered Aug 2025; INS Dunagiri (3rd MDL) launched. Remaining 4 built at GRSE. Displacement ~6,670 t, 149 m length, Shakti EW system
